name: Seductive Shadows
source:
Seductive Shadows is an adult visual novel in which you play as the protagonist exploring a new bustling city and starting classes as a student at Alfonso University, a multi-discipline arts school.

But Destiny leads you to another path in which you begin unraveling occult secrets linked to your existence. 

Strange visions and supernatural encounters leave you questioning reality and beyond. What truths lie buried in your forgotten past and uncertain future?

[From [url=https://chysagames.itch.io/seductive-shadows]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Seitive Shadows是一部成人视觉小说，你在其中扮演主角，探索一个新的繁华城市，并以阿方索大学（一所多学科艺术学校）的学生身份开始上课。

但命运将你引向另一条道路，你开始解开与你的存在相关的神秘秘密。

奇怪的景象和超自然的遭遇让你质疑现实和超越。在你遗忘的过去和不确定的未来中埋藏着哪些真相？

[来自[url=https://chysagames.itch.io/seductive-shadows]Itch.io[/url]]
